logger.doc:name: Log Notification Dispatch
logger.message: Preparing compliance notification dispatch. Mode: #[vars.notificationMode default 'ATTACHMENT']

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output text/plain var prefix = p('email.subjectPrefix') default "[REGULATORY COMPLIANCE]" var entity = vars.runContext.entityCode default "ENT0091" var report = vars.runContext.reportType default "STR" var seq = vars.runContext.sequenceNumber as Number as String {format: "000"} var statusLabel = if ((vars.runMetrics.recordCount default 0) == 0) "NIL REPORT" else (vars.runMetrics.recordCount as String) ++ " FLAGGED" var alertSuffix = if (vars.volumeAnalysis.hasDeviationAlert default false) " [VOLUME ALERT]" else "" --- prefix ++ " " ++ entity ++ " " ++ report ++ " Seq #" ++ seq ++ " - " ++ statusLabel ++ alertSuffix

%dw 2.0 output text/plain fun formatAmount(amt: Any) = if (amt == null) "0.00" else (amt as Number as String {format: "#,##0.00"}) var runCtx = vars.runContext default {} var metrics = vars.runMetrics default {} var volAnalysis = vars.volumeAnalysis default {} var flagGroups = (vars.extractedRecords default []) groupBy ((item) -> item.flag_code default item.flagCode default "UNKNOWN") var isNil = (metrics.recordCount default 0) == 0 var hasAlert = volAnalysis.hasDeviationAlert default false var isSecureLink = (vars.notificationMode default "ATTACHMENT") == "SECURE_LINK" --- "

Regulatory Compliance Notification - " ++ (runCtx.reportType default "STR") ++ "

Entity: " ++ (runCtx.entityName default "Apex Global Banking") ++ " (" ++ (runCtx.entityCode default "ENT0091") ++ ")

A regulatory compliance report has been produced and verified.

Run ID" ++ (runCtx.runId default "N/A") ++ "
Reporting Period" ++ (runCtx.periodStart as String) ++ " to " ++ (runCtx.periodEnd as String) ++ "
Sequence Number#" ++ (runCtx.sequenceNumber as Number as String {format: "000"}) ++ "
Flagged Records" ++ ((metrics.recordCount default 0) as String) ++ "
Total Amount" ++ (runCtx.currency default "USD") ++ " " ++ formatAmount(metrics.totalAmount default 0.00) ++ "
Completeness Check" ++ (metrics.completenessResult default "PASS") ++ "
SHA-256 Checksum" ++ (metrics.checksum default "NIL_REPORT") ++ "
Archive Location" ++ (vars.archiveSubmissionFilePath default "N/A") ++ "
" ++ (if (isSecureLink) "

Note: Files exceed email gateway limits and are available on the secure portal: Download Report

" else "

Submission CSV and Summary files are attached.

") ++ "
"

logger.doc:name: Log Sending Secure Link
logger.message: Sending notification email with SECURE DOWNLOAD LINK to #[p('email.to')]

logger.doc:name: Log Sending with Attachments
logger.message: Sending notification email with DIRECT ATTACHMENTS to #[p('email.to')]
